entries.name: Improved Wrath
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by $/1000;S1 sec and its Mana cost by $s2%.

entries.name: Genesis
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by $s1%.

entries.name: Moonglow
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Moonfire
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by $s1%.

entries.name: Nature's Majesty
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by $s1%.

entries.name: Nature's Reach
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by $m1% and improves your chance to hit by $m2%.

entries.name: Improved Entangling Roots
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by $m1%, and its victims can take up to $m1% more damage without interrupting the effect.

entries.name: Nature's Splendor
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by ${$m1/1000} sec, your Regrowth spell by ${$m2/1000} sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by ${$m3/1000} sec.

entries.name: Insect Swarm
entries.descriptionTemplate: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by $s2% and causing $o1 Nature damage over $d.

entries.name: Vengeance
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Improved Starfire
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by $/1000;S1 sec and Starfire has a $s2% chance to stun its target for $16922d.

entries.name: Overgrowth
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by $s1.

entries.name: Nature's Grace
entries.descriptionTemplate: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by $m1% for $16886d.

entries.name: Eclipse
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next $s3 Starfire spells by ${$m2/-1000}.2 sec. Stores up to $408255u charges. Lasts $408255d.

entries.name: Moonfury
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by $m1%.

entries.name: Moonkin Form
entries.descriptionTemplate:
Transforms the Druid into Moonkin Form. While in this form, the armor contribution from items is increased by $24905s1%, Omen of Clarity gains $s5% increased chance to trigger, and all party members within $24907a1 yards have their critical strike chance increased by $24907s1%, exclusive with Leader of the Pack. The Moonkin cannot cast healing spells while shapeshifted.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

entries.name: Ferocity
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Mangle, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by $/10;s1 Rage or Energy.

entries.name: Heart of the Wild
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Intellect by $s1%.  In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by $s2% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by $s3%.

entries.name: Feral Swiftness
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by $m2%, and increases your chance to Dodge by $m1%.

entries.name: Feral Instinct
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by $s2% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were ${$m1/5} $llevel:levels; higher.

entries.name: Brutal Impact
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by $/1000;S1 sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by ${$m2/-1000} sec.

entries.name: Thick Hide
entries.descriptionTemplate: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain $s2 additional base Armor per level and another ${$m1/100}.2 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

entries.name: Savage Fury
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by $s1%.

entries.name: Feral Charge
entries.descriptionTemplate:
$?a5487|a9634[|CFFFFFFFFRequires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form|R][|CFFFF2020Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form|R]
Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for $19675d.

$@spelltooltip414924

entries.name: Sharpened Claws
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by $s1%.

entries.name: Shredding Attacks
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by $m1 and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by ${$m2/-10}.

entries.name: Mangle
entries.descriptionTemplate: Mangle the target for $s2% normal damage plus $s1.

entries.name: Predatory Strikes
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by $s1% of your level.

entries.name: Primal Fury
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance to gain an additional $/10;16959s1 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a $m2% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

entries.name: Predatory Instincts
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by $m1%.

entries.name: Leader of the Pack
entries.descriptionTemplate: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the critical strike chance of all party members within $24932a1 yards by $24932s1%, exclusive with Moonkin Aura.

entries.name: King of the Jungle
entries.descriptionTemplate: Tiger's Fury now instantly grants you $s1 Energy.

entries.name: Natural Reaction
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your dodge chance by $m1%, and gives you a $m2% chance to gain ${$417053m1/10} Rage each time you dodge.

entries.name: Rend and Tear
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by $m1%.

entries.name: Berserk
entries.descriptionTemplate:
$?a5487|a9634|a3025[|CFFFFFFFFReuires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form|R][|CFFFF2020Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form|R]
Causes your Mangle ability to strike up to $s3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by $s1%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts $d.

entries.name: Nature's Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting Arcane and Nature spells.

entries.name: Furor
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance to gain $/10;17057s1 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. When you shift into Cat Form, you will regain ${100*($m2/100)}% of the Energy you had when you were last in Cat Form, plus ${10*($m2/100)} Energy for each second you spent not in Bear Form, Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form, up to a maximum of ${100*($m2/100)} Energy.

entries.name: Naturalist
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch spell by $/1000;S1 sec and increases all damage you deal by $m2%.

entries.name: Subtlety
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Natural Shapeshifter
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by $s1%.

entries.name: Reflection
entries.descriptionTemplate: Allows $s1% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

entries.name: Gift of Nature
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Gift of the Earthmother
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the global cooldown by ${$m1/-1000}.1 seconds on your Rejuvenation, Swiftmend, and Wild Growth spells.

entries.name: Tranquil Spirit
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch and Tranquility spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Rejuvenation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by $s1%.

entries.name: Swiftmend
entries.descriptionTemplate: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

entries.name: Nature's Swiftness
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

entries.name: Living Spirit
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Spirit by $m1%.

entries.name: Improved Tranquility
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by $s1% and its cooldown by $m2%.

entries.name: Improved Regrowth
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by $s1%.

entries.name: Wild Growth
entries.descriptionTemplate: Heals the target and their party for $o1 over $d. Party members must be within $a1 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.
